
---
title: "My Library"
---

A searchable catalog of books I have read or am currently reading, including information about the books and links to my personal reflections.

## Books

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Import the catalog
books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Create clickable titles for books with individual pages
library_table <- books |>
  mutate(
    title = if_else(
      !is.na(book_page) & nzchar(book_page),
      paste0(
        '<a href="',
        sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", book_page),
        '">',
        htmltools::htmlEscape(title),
        '</a>'
      ),
      htmltools::htmlEscape(title)
    )
  ) |>
  select(
  title, author, total_pages, status,
  date_started, date_finished
)

# Display the searchable catalog
datatable(
  library_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = c(
  "Title", "Author", "Pages",
  "Status", "Date Started", "Date Finished"
),
  escape = 2:6,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    searching = TRUE,
    ordering = TRUE
  )
)
```
